disposition: Reject the frozen CRC-gap study: both VNDB target hosts miss >=2 percent paired-median gain and >=9/12 faster, and their original strict memory sampling coverage gates fail. No repeatable nontarget regression. No further acquisition or duplicate product PR.
limits: All original ZIP/member/source/semantic/media/memory/CRC bytes were verified by the exact reviewed hosted reader.
